name: pw-invoice-docno-index
description: Offline CLI to index Perfect Water / CoS invoice Doc Nos from filenames to prevent duplicate uploads

scripts.test:fixtures:dir: npm run build && node dist/index.js --dir fixtures/sample-pdfs --outdir test-out-dir && echo 'Directory scan test completed successfully'
scripts.test:fixtures:list: npm run build && node dist/index.js --files fixtures/sample-names.txt --outdir test-out-list && echo 'Filename list test completed successfully'
scripts.test:fixtures:known: npm run build && node dist/index.js --dir fixtures/sample-pdfs --known fixtures/known-index.md --outdir test-out-known && echo 'Known index comparison test completed successfully'

author: Grant Brown
